editorial:
Imagine you are stuck in the middle of the Arizona desert with two government agents and a mob snitch who just wants to disappear. That is exactly how things start here. You get a mix of a crime thriller and a scary ghost story that feels like a wild ride. The vibe is gritty and dusty, making you feel the heat of the sun and the tension of being chased by hitmen. It starts off as a simple game of cat and mouse, but once the group turns onto a creepy abandoned road called Route 666, things get way weirder than anyone expected.

You will probably love how the movie switches from an action flick to a horror show. The pacing is quick, though some of the special effects feel a bit old now. Still, the chemistry between the characters keeps you interested. If you enjoy B-movies with a bit of a weird streak, you should definitely give this a shot.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head when the group realizes the road is cursed by the ghosts of an old prison chain gang. The spirits don't care who is a good guy or a bad guy; they just want revenge on anyone who travels their path. After a brutal fight with both the mobsters and the undead, most of the cast gets picked off. In the end, the ghosts win, proving that some roads are better left untravelled.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves old school horror and crime stories.
